body.text: When is thermal hydrotherapy helpful vs contraindicated after surgery?

Supervised aquatic physiotherapy in warm mineral water can reduce joint loading and ease chronic osteoarthritis, fibromyalgia, or late-stage orthopedic stiffness once tissues are completely healed. Immediately after surgery, however, thermal immersion is contraindicated because heat, standing water, and dissolved minerals increase infection, swelling, and wound-opening risks.

Clinical wound-care guidance from [Addenbrooke's Hospital (CUH NHS)](https://www.cuh.nhs.uk/patient-information/caring-for-your-surgical-wound/), [Torbay and South Devon NHS](https://www.torbayandsouthdevon.nhs.uk/uploads/25864.pdf?last-updated=20250328), and [Collingwood Surgery NHS](https://collingwoodsurgery.nhs.uk/collingwood/common-questions/operations-tests-and-procedureshow-soon-can-i-go-swimming-after-surgery) states clearly that patients must avoid swimming, baths, and hot tubs until stitches are removed or dissolved and the incision is completely closed. Thermal baths are also routinely contraindicated during active infection, uncontrolled hypertension, unstable heart conditions, or acute deep vein thrombosis.
Which licensed physical-therapy thermal centers exist in Bursa, Afyon and Yalova?

Türkiye separates recreational thermal spa hotels from Ministry of Health–licensed physical therapy and rehabilitation (Fizik Tedavi ve Rehabilitasyon) centers staffed by specialist physicians and physiotherapists. For structured post-hospital or chronic musculoskeletal programs, prioritize medically licensed facilities in Bursa, Afyonkarahisar, or Yalova rather than leisure resorts.

Why must your physician clear thermal water immersion before booking?

Thermal springs in Bursa, Yalova, and Afyon vary widely in mineral content and natural water temperature—often emerging hot enough to dilate blood vessels, drop blood pressure, or worsen post-surgical edema. A physician clearance confirms your incision integrity, cardiovascular stability, and exact safe water temperature and session duration.

Even when water immersion is off-limits—such as two weeks after knee or spine surgery—a licensed rehabilitation center can still deliver dry-land physiotherapy, electrotherapy, and guided gait training while you rest in a quiet mountain or thermal town. Separating dry rehab from wet thermal immersion prevents costly last-minute cancellations.

items: Obtain written clearance from your operating surgeon or physical medicine physician specifying whether water immersion is permitted.
Confirm your chosen facility holds a Turkish Ministry of Health physical therapy license, not only a hotel spa permit.
Verify maximum safe water temperature and session length (often 15–20 minutes) if you have blood-pressure or cardiac history.
Bring your full English discharge summary, recent imaging, and medication list for the intake rehabilitation physician.
Arrange step-free room access, walk-in showers, and private door-to-door transfers from Istanbul or Sabiha Gökçen airports.

body.text: How do you plan a 7-day restorative stay?

Structure a seven-day thermal rehabilitation stay around an intake physician assessment on Day 1, short morning physiotherapy or hydrotherapy sessions on Days 2 through 6, and unhurried afternoons for rest, gentle flat walks, and nutrition. Overpacking sightseeing or soaking twice daily often triggers fatigue rather than recovery.

faq.q: Can I enter a thermal pool one week after surgery in Türkiye?
faq.a: No. Fresh surgical incisions must not be submerged in thermal pools, hot tubs, or baths due to infection and wound-healing risks. Always wait for written clearance from your surgeon.

faq.q: What is the difference between a thermal hotel and a thermal rehab center?
faq.a: A thermal hotel focuses on leisure bathing and spa wellness. A licensed physical-therapy thermal center employs physical medicine physicians and physiotherapists who prescribe supervised rehabilitation protocols.

faq.q: Is Bursa or Afyon easier to reach from Istanbul?
faq.a: Bursa and Yalova are much closer—roughly 1.5 to 2.5 hours from Istanbul by road or ferry—making them easier for patients avoiding long transfers or connecting domestic flights.

faq.q: Can my travel companion stay with me during thermal rehabilitation?
faq.a: Yes. Most rehabilitation-adjacent hotels in Bursa, Yalova, and Afyon accommodate companions easily, and companions can enjoy regional cuisine, parks, or separate thermal bathing while you attend therapy.

faq.q: What should I pack for a 7-day thermal rehab trip?
faq.a: Pack non-slip pool sandals, loose easy-on clothing for physiotherapy sessions, a light robe, your prescribed medications in original packaging, and printed English medical summaries.
